title: Texas Homeowner Reportedly Spent $3,000 to Contest AI-Flagged Warning of Insurance Nonrenewal

behaviors.text: In Texas, homeowners including a person reported warnings against insurance nonrenewals based on aerial imagery flagged by AI systems.
While the AI system appears to have functioned as intended, critics argue it lacks adequate human oversight and imposes material and emotional burdens on policyholders.
Companies such as State Farm and Nationwide used vendors like CAPE Analytics and Nearmap.
